data.text: [00:04]We asked fifty students various questions about their attitudes to money and the results are as follows:

[00:12.9]Firstly, forty percent of people said they would basically describe themselves as a ‘saver’. `[00:20.7]Forty-five percent said they were a ‘spender’ and fifteen percent weren’t sure or said they were a bit of both.

[00:29]For the second question, we asked about lending and borrowing money. `[00:34.8]Two thirds of people said they would lend fifty pounds to a friend. `[00:39.7]However, the majority of those people said they would be worried about doing so, in case it spoilt their friendship.

[00:48]The third question was about credit cards. `[00:51.9]Eight out of ten people said they used a credit card regularly. `[00:56]And only a minority of those people paid off their bill completely at the end of each month.
